newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy commercial vehicle sales slump in July/Aug.
newsitem.headline: Italy commercial vehicle sales slump in July/Aug.

text.p: Italian commercial vehicle sales fell during the summer holiday period, falling by 1.2 percent in July and slumping 10.2 percent in August, according to industry association data.

July sales totalled 11,772 against 11,917 in July 1995 while deliveries in August fell to 4,936 against 5,494 a year ago, a joint statement from makers association Anfia and importing body Unrae said.
But in the first eight months of 1996, cumulative sales showed a year-on-year rise of 4.32 percent to 95,605 vehicles, due to healthy sales at the beginning of the year.
Italian manufacturers saw August deliveries down 11.71 percent to 2,503, taking their market share to 50.7 percent from 51.6 percent in the same month last year.
Fiat Auto sales dropped 18.69 percent to 1,918, but Iveco sales rose 12.54 percent to 368 and Piaggo sales were up 2.71 percent to 208.

Among the main foreign marques imported, Ford saw sales fall 23.87 percent to 571 vehicles but Mercedes sales jumped 75.9 percent to 438. Nissan sales were down 4.35 percent to 330, Renault fell 19.2 percent to 282 and Volkswagen slipped 6.83 percent to 259.
